mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous 6 months indicates a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST drops by more than 10% over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening supply side, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous 3 months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases & UNRATE increases in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS decreases and UNRATE increases over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over the previous quarter signals a strong economic expansion, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increases by more than 2% in one quarter during a late-cycle expansion.
